keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Crystal Palace 0, Nottingham Forest 1. Dan Ndoye (Nottingham Forest) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner.
Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Walter Benítez (Crystal Palace).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Crystal Palace 1, Nottingham Forest 1. Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Quinten Timber.
Goal! Crystal Palace 2, Nottingham Forest 1. Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Adam Wharton with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Crystal Palace 2, Nottingham Forest 1.
Second Half begins Crystal Palace 2, Nottingham Forest 1.
Goal! Crystal Palace 3, Nottingham Forest 1. Yéremy Pino (Crystal Palace) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Yéremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Ibrahim Sangaré replaces Xaver Schlager.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Callum Hudson-Odoi replaces Dan Ndoye.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Chris Wood replaces Liam Delap.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Honest Ahanor replaces Jefferson Lerma.
Ola Aina (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Ismaïla Sarr replaces Yéremy Pino.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Eddie Nketiah replaces Jørgen Strand Larsen.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Arnaud Kalimuendo replaces Ola Aina.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Dwight McNeil replaces Daichi Kamada.
Murillo (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Crystal Palace 3, Nottingham Forest 1.
